correctness.rationale: The nontrivial equilibrium polynomial has degree precisely M. In one dimension k asymptotically stable roots require 2k-1 distinct roots, implying k <= ceil(M/2). For any ordered roots with sum < 1, decreasing elementary symmetric coefficients make every coefficient of (E(y)-E(1))/(y-1) strictly positive; choosing all s_j=j!b_j produces exactly F(y)=-yE(y), M simple positive roots, and ceil(M/2) attracting ones. Nonzero derivatives make these robust. Exact rational identity and derivative checks completed for 72 constructions in verify.py. Finite checks are supporting, not the all-M proof.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp, group-size-resolved upper bound and positive-parameter realization for the natural number of coexisting attracting endemic states in a single well-mixed higher-order contagion process. It resolves an explicitly motivated arbitrary-order question from the 2023 primary analysis and distinguishes all-order emergence from multiple-population symmetry breaking. Positive lower-order rates and openness make the construction structurally meaningful rather than a deleted-coefficient artifact.
